name: Slide Off
summary: Slide-to-delete: drag the bin across and the chat above leans in, then gets swallowed whole
about: Slide Off makes deleting a chat a deliberate swipe. As you drag the glowing bin along the dark track, its lid opens, the label slides away and the chat card above tilts back and blushes. Let go early and the knob springs home with a bounce; reach the end and the card is sucked into the bin, the lid slams with a burst of sparks and the track folds into a round green tick with Undo.
how: Drag the bin knob to the right; the lid opens and the chat card leans back as you go.
Let go before the end and it springs back home; nothing is deleted.
Reach the end: the card is sucked into the bin, the lid slams and sparks fly.
The track folds into a green tick and offers Undo, which pops the chat back out.
Keyboard: Tab to the slider, use the arrows, or press End or Enter to go all the way; Esc sends it back.
